EventDescription: Learn how the Winter Rush event works
EventCatOverviewDesc: How the event works and how to win credits
EventCatCommandsDesc: List and explanation of all commands
EventCatItemsDesc: Items you can buy or find in the snow
EventOverviewContent:
Welcome to **Winter Rush**, the **Orion Hosting** (`orionhost.xyz`) 1-week board game event!

🎯 **Goal:**
Reach **Tile 50** before the end of the week and donate **Snowflakes** to the **Lodge**.

💰 **Rewards (End of Event):**
• You win **credits equal to the Snowflakes you donated to the Lodge**.
• **Podium Bonus** for the first 3 players to reach Tile 50:
  🥇 1st place: **+50 credits**
  🥈 2nd place: **+30 credits**
  🥉 3rd place: **+20 credits**
EventCommandsContent:
• `/ride` — Ski down a Green, Red, or Black slope to advance on the board.
• `/search` — Search in the snow for Snowflakes or items (costs 1 energy).
• `/lodge <amount>` — Donate Snowflakes to the Lodge (max 25/day).
• `/shop` — Buy items with your Snowflakes.
• `/use <item>` — Use an item from your inventory.
• `/target <user> <type>` — Throw a snowball (-2 tiles) or pickpocket (-15 Snowflakes).
• `/user [user]` — View your (or another player's) stats & inventory.
• `/board` — View the current board and leaderboard.
EventItemsContent:
• 🛡️ **Full-Face Helmet (30 ❄️)** — Blocks the next negative trap, snowball, avalanche, or pickpocket.
• 🧲 **Snowflake Magnet (35 ❄️)** — Steals 10 Snowflakes from up to 2 closest players.
• 🎿 **Turbo Ski Wax (40 ❄️)** — Doubles the distance of your next `/ride`.
• 🧨 **Avalanche Firecracker (55 ❄️)** — Pushes back all unfinished players ahead of you by 3 tiles.
